# Code Anchors: Settings Key Catalogue

- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — the catalogue itself: each row's written name, normalized name, built-in and general-key fallback, plus the membership lookup, the normalized-name translation and the derived inverse.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/settings.ts` — the reader deriving its keys from the catalogue instead of enumerating them a second time.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/hub.ts` — the workspace-defaults normalizer, whose membership test is the catalogue lookup rather than a comparison of a key's two spellings.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.ts` — the writer translating back to written names through the derived inverse rather than a hand-maintained one.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/resolve.ts` — the resolve-by-name argument translating through the same catalogue, including the specific-over-general fallback the rows declare.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/resolve.spec.ts` — the every-declared-key coverage pinning that a key is readable, layerable and resolvable together.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.spec.ts` — writer coverage over the same catalogue, including the add-only and byte-identical properties.
- `libs/workspace/src/manifest.ts` — the second registration surface a hub-defaultable key still needs; its allowlist rejects unlisted keys outright.
